summary.text: Blood Rainbow Flash is Song Zi Xing's immortal killer move.

claims.text: Inside Blood Tu Su, Song Zi Xing asks whether any escape can surpass blood rainbow flash in speed. When Vicious Lightning Fiend and Blazing Demonic Immortal Dan Qiao join forces, Song Zi Xing turns into a bloody rainbow and vanishes. The immortal killer move is extremely fast. He flies out of the battlefield at once and even discards the blood path Immortal Gu used to build that field. A few breaths later the rainbow has already covered an enormous distance. When it fades he finds an unchanging mountain below him and realizes he is in an illusion. When he is pressed from all sides, he uses the same speed again. The name of blood rainbow flash is famous in Central Continent, and the lone cultivators chasing him are left behind.

Blood rainbow flash is extremely fast and nimble. Killer moves meant to obstruct him have little effect, and the gap to the pursuers grows, though Illusion Garden is already set. Observers at rank seven say it is faster than cloud shock sail and as fast as purple heaven lightning wings, which they call a movement killer move in the top ten even in Central Continent. It is a blood path killer move. When the encirclement tightens, the figure they trap is blown to pieces. It is not his real body. His real body has stayed inside Blood Tu Su.

After Blood Tu Su collapses, he flies out in a bloody rainbow. Gu Immortals send immortal killer moves at him. He uses blood rainbow flash again and evades most of them. After an explosion opens a crack in Illusion Garden, he activates it once more and vanishes beyond their sight.
